scope: Response to the September 2026 borderline FSE review; repository provenance, not external preregistration.

endpoints: mean sequential candidates invoked under fixed seed order
answer_breadth_cost_curve.selection_rule: Report every fixed k; do not select k using test outcomes. Union coverage is order invariant; cost uses the declared seed order and stops at the first accepted repair.

temperature_extension.selection_rule: Report both cells; do not use either test split to tune temperature.

mechanism_sensitivity.method: For each paired mechanism contrast, estimate the cluster-robust standard error from the frozen 95 percent interval and report the two-sided alpha 0.05, 80 percent-power normal-approximation MDE as (1.96 + 0.8416) times that standard error.
mechanism_sensitivity.interpretation: MDE is design sensitivity, not evidence that a null effect is exactly zero.

literature_audit.scope: Peer-reviewed or publicly archived educational program-repair studies from 2021 through 2026 that generate executable repairs for student or competition submissions with a neural or LLM component.
coding_fields: number of generated or iterated candidates per input
whether repair coverage uses a union over multiple candidates
whether a one-candidate decoding-matched control is reported
whether inference calls or candidate budget is reported
literature_audit.rule: Code only statements verifiable in the paper or official artifact; mark unreported fields NR rather than infer them.
